input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: Smoke run first launched in the foreground with a 110 s timeout and was killed; relaunched in the background (its training cache survived, so the second smoke reported 0 s of training).

doc_friction.issue: pyenv.py example lists pytest numpy matplotlib, but codesign-cant also needs cma (pyproject.toml); a first pyenv call without it cost a second install. Reading the project's pyproject dependencies (or `pytest -r`) first would avoid it.

In-run response check compares records with != and prints FAIL on every NaN record (third milestone in a row); verify.py's NaN-aware re-check is the real check. Not fixed here to keep 12e a verbatim copy of 12d's harness.

notes: Milestone 12e of codesign-cant: 100 ms training-lag ceiling at ten seeds per geometry against 12c's stored 125 ms ten seeds. 9 of 9 pre-registered predictions held: 326 vs 196 identified-lag crashes of 3,840 (MWU p 0.040, paired Wilcoxon p 0.0011), 75 ms law 893 vs 695 (p 0.0001); 100 ms saves 3-4% mass and 0.1-0.15 s rise. Reproduction checks exact (verify.py NaN-aware 0 of 96 / 0 of 108). Training 70 min on 4 cores. A sibling session landed milestone 12f (#18315) during the run; merged main in and resolved LOG/README/DRAFT/project.json conflicts by keeping both. Local checks: build.py ok, check_numbers 141/141, check_md_links ok, check_posts ok.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a grad student scripting, running and writing up one pre-registered ten-seed rerun with stats and a paper edit

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
